title: state
description: Where runtime data lives (ROADMAP.md, Where runtime data lives). bin/state-root.sh is the one reader: no script carries a root, a tree name or a name limit of its own. A root is COQ_STATE or COQ_CACHE when set to an absolute path, else <XDG home or $HOME/<fallback>>/<namespace>/<repo>. BREADCRUMB 2026-10-12 WO-20261012-7e13: this schema has no $id on purpose. The other schemas carry a relative $id (coq/events/schema/event.schema.json) and use no $ref; this one uses #/$defs refs, and python3-jsonschema 4.10.3 in the lint image resolves them against a relative $id as coq/config/coq/config/state.schema.json and raises RefResolutionError, which failed the configs step of make lint. Rejected: repeating the root and tree definitions inline (two copies to keep in step). Cost: none; lint finds the schema by its file name beside the config.

trees.description: The directories under the state root, by the name scripts ask for. Dated trees hold YYYY/MM/YYYYMMDDHHMMSS-<descriptive name>.<ext>; the others are lookups keyed by name.

name_max.description: the longest <descriptive name>, in characters, of a dated entry file

env.description: the variable that names the root outright; an absolute path

xdg_env.description: the XDG base directory variable; used only when it holds an absolute path, as the XDG specification says

home_fallback.description: relative to $HOME, used when the XDG variable is unset or relative

namespace.description: the directory under the XDG home that holds every repository's root

tree.description: a relative path under the state root
